name: io.github.idoo/garmin-mcp
title: Garmin MCP
description: MCP server for Garmin Connect IQ developers: store portal, SDK builds, simulator. Read-only default.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose write tools; public actions still need your approval

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to enable: empty for defaults, 'all', or e.g. '+connect'

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_SDK
environmentVariables.description: Connect IQ SDK path or installed version (default: SDK Manager's current SDK)

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser for sign-in: a path, or 'bundled' for Chrome for Testing

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_PORTAL_COOKIES
environmentVariables.description: Developer portal cookies for CI (no renewal; lasts about 15 days)
